meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可管理作者习惯、启动本地 Dashboard。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「记住我的写作习惯」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记住你的写作习惯,一键打开小说创作工作台
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在写或准备写网络小说,想要一个统一入口管理写作工具。
copy.tagline_en: Track your writing habits and jump straight into your novel workspace.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write or plan to write web novels and want one hub for your writing tools.

howto.what: 装上后，当你说「我想写小说」这类请求时，它把请求分发到对应的网文子工具；也能记住你的写作习惯、打开本地工作台、检查版本更新。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story、/网文 等触发词，或说「我想写小说」这类请求时接管；意图模糊时先问你想做什么。

say.note: 先问你写长篇还是短篇，再分发到对应子工具。

say.text: 记住我的写作习惯：我习惯先写大纲
say.note: 写入工作区的作者记忆，成功前会给出回执。
启动本地 Dashboard 并返回访问地址。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask something like "I want to write a novel" it routes the request to the matching web-fiction sub-skill. It can also store your writing habits, launch a local dashboard, and check for version updates.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you type /story or /网文, or say something like "I want to write a novel". If your intent is unclear, it asks what you want to do first.

say_en.text: I want to write a novel
say_en.note: Asks long or short form, then routes to a sub-skill.

say_en.text: Remember my writing habit: I outline first
say_en.note: Saves it to the workspace author memory with a receipt.
Starts the local dashboard and returns its URL.
